verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents a Batch API for processing groups of requests asynchronously when immediate results aren't needed, which covers the async batch-submission half of the story. Nothing in the evidence documents a batch discount versus real-time pricing; the pricing and service-tier pages cited mention only free credits, rate limits, and priority processing. Missing for 10: a documented batch discount versus real-time pricing, job lifecycle details (submission, status, retrieval), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
